en: The postcard is a black-and-white photograph depicting two traditional Norwegian wooden buildings surrounded by trees. The buildings are constructed from timber and are elevated on logs. The building on the left appears symmetrical with decorative wooden trims under its eaves, and the building on the right shows characteristic Norwegian woodwork, notably a chevron-patterned door. The ground is grassy, and the area is forested with birch and pine trees. There is white text at the bottom of the image indicating the location and subject.
